title: Teachers by seniority
statementMd:
List teachers with the year they were hired, longest-serving first (ties by name).

Expected columns: `name`, `hired_year`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, hired_year FROM teachers ORDER BY hired_year, name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
